_comment: Append-only. One object per signal, written when its h=20 window closes (or is censored at data end). Never back-filled: no entry with signal_date earlier than opened_utc may be inserted. Signals fill at the NEXT session's open; h in {5,10,20} fixed-horizon outcomes are recorded per signal; censored signals are flagged and excluded from the endpoint, never scored as wins or losses.

schema.signal_date: YYYY-MM-DD (WIB), session t whose bar triggered: low(t) < lo20(t) and close(t) > lo20(t), lo20 = prior-20-session rolling low shifted 1
schema.entry_date: YYYY-MM-DD (WIB), first session strictly after signal_date; fill at its open
schema.horizons: object keyed '5','10','20'; each {exit_date, exit_close, gross_return, net_return (after 0.60% RT), ihsg_return, excess_ihsg, ewbook_return, excess_ewbook}; excess = net_return - benchmark return over the identical window
schema.censored: bool, data ended before the h=20 window closed; excluded from the endpoint
